Command: cd /workspace/project && cat -A split_lines.sh && printf '---\n' && ./split_lines.sh $'a\nb,c'
Read-only: false
Sandbox: disabled
Exit code: 2

STDOUT:
#!/usr/bin/env bash$
# split_lines.sh: print every field of the first argument on its own line$
IFS=$'\n'$
read -r -a parts <<< "$1"$
for p in "${parts[@]}"; do$
  echo "[$p]"$
done$


STDERR:
bash: line 1: printf: --: invalid option
printf: usage: printf [-v var] format [arguments]
